gate_decision: stage180 records only the readiness admission queue after Stage179 verifier evidence; it keeps reviewed readiness, real corpus materialization, daemon execution, matched benchmark, true Rust default daemon, and default/product switches closed
name: stage180-matched-benchmark-reviewed-corpus-readiness-admission-queue-gate
readiness_requirements: Stage179 verifier evidence must remain reproducible from an explicit Stage178 root
Rust production dae run command must be admitted before readiness can open
Go default daemon and Rust opt-in daemon must run against the same reviewed corpus
production listener, tc attach, listen_socket_map, and eBPF evidence must be collected
startup, reload listener reuse, BPF owner transfer, DNS cache, RuntimeOverview, and cleanup parity must be proven
matched Go/Rust benchmark artifacts and metrics must be recorded
default daemon and product-chain switch gates must be recertified after benchmark evidence
remaining_blockers: reviewed real corpus is not ready
Rust production dae run command is not admitted
real matched benchmark corpus is not materialized
Go default daemon and Rust opt-in daemon have not been run on the same reviewed corpus
matched Go/Rust default daemon benchmark has not executed
default daemon and product-chain switches remain closed

rows.boundary: artifact verification alone does not make reviewed corpus ready
rows.requirement: keep explicit Stage178 root verification reproducible with file set, digest, redaction, runtime scope, command binding, and closed flags

rows.boundary: Stage156 opt-in identity and Stage157 entrypoint evidence are not production daemon admission
rows.requirement: admit a production-shaped Rust dae run command before benchmark execution can use a Rust daemon candidate

rows.boundary: command templates and verifier artifacts are not daemon execution
rows.requirement: run Go default daemon and Rust opt-in daemon on the same reviewed corpus with the Stage172/173 command binding

rows.boundary: runtime evidence scope text is not production attach evidence
rows.requirement: prove production listener bind, tc attach, listen_socket_map key 0/1 writes, and eBPF attach evidence

rows.boundary: parity requirements remain blockers until executed against daemon lifecycle
rows.requirement: prove startup order, reload listener reuse, BPF owner transfer, DNS cache migration, RuntimeOverview, and reload cleanup parity

rows.boundary: reviewed artifact digest is not benchmark data
rows.requirement: record matched Go/Rust default daemon benchmark metrics and artifacts from the reviewed corpus

rows.boundary: readiness queue does not switch daemon defaults
rows.requirement: recertify true Rust default daemon admission, default path mutation, and product-chain switch only after benchmark evidence

validation_commands: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p dae-cli --bin dae-cli-optin --quiet -- runtime stage180-matched-benchmark-reviewed-corpus-readiness-admission-queue-gate
